"Diablo" is coming to Netflix! Blizzard Entertainment officially confirmed at this year's BlizzCon that an animated series based on the popular action role-playing game series is in development at Netflix. This news is certainly welcome for fans, as the first rumors about a possible "Diablo" series began circulating back in 2018. However, nothing came of it at the time.
